_comment: Golden LLM response fixture for the review domain. Hand-built against PlanResult, ReviewData, SynthesisResult — a valid per-stage output set for a product comparison review. Review forbids quiz_arena, so no quiz call runs and enrichment_response is null. Drift canary consumed by tests/test_llm_response_fixtures.py.

video_meta.title: Nimbus X2 vs Strider Pro: The Only Standing Desk Review You Need

plan_response.reasoning: Head-to-head product review with measured specs, a pros/cons rundown, and a clear verdict.
plan_response.corePromise: Know which desk to buy for your budget and height
plan_response.uniqueAngle: Wobble tested with a dial gauge at three heights instead of a shake test

extractionGuidance.primaryFocus: Comparison rows with measured numbers; verdict verbatim
extractionGuidance.watchOutFor: Sponsored segment at 12:40 — exclude promo claims from specs

plan_response.userGoal: Decide between the two desks before the sale ends

tabs.label: Head to Head
tabs.goal: Feature-by-feature winner calls with measured numbers.

tabs.label: Pros & Cons
tabs.goal: Strengths and weaknesses side by side.

pros: Fastest motor tested this year at 38mm per second
Dial-gauge wobble of 0.8mm at 120cm height — best in class
Anti-collision sensor works with soft obstacles like a chair arm
Cable tray and two grommets included at no extra cost
cons: Crossbar design limits under-desk drawer options
Only a 5-year warranty versus 10 on the Strider Pro

bestFor: Anyone standing more than half the day
notFor: Very tall users who need the 133cm top end
Buyers who want a drawer under the desktop
verdict.bottomLine: The Nimbus X2 wins on the things you feel every day — stability and speed — and loses only on paper.

synthesis_response.tldr: The Nimbus X2 beats the Strider Pro on measured stability and speed; the Strider wins warranty and height range.
keyTakeaways: Nimbus X2 wobble measured 0.8mm vs 1.9mm on the Strider Pro
Strider Pro's 10-year warranty doubles the Nimbus coverage
Very tall users need the Strider's 133cm top end
synthesis_response.masterSummary: A dial-gauge-instrumented head-to-head between the Nimbus X2 and Strider Pro standing desks covering stability, motor speed, noise, warranty, and accessories, ending in a conditional recommendation: Nimbus X2 for most buyers, Strider Pro for the very tall or warranty-minded.
